newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Unicom rated mkt perform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Unicom rated mkt perform.

text.p: -- Everen Securities said Thursday it continued to rate Unicom Corp, parent of Commonwealth Edison Co, a market performer after the company said its nuclear operating costs would sharply escalate.
-- On Thursday, Commonwealth said it would increase its nuclear operating budget in 1997 to $1.2 billion, up 11 percent from 1996.
-- "We expect (Unicom) to continue to be volatile and be notable only for aggressive income investors," Everen said.
-- Estimates remain at $2.90 a share for 1997 and $3.00 for 1998, Everen said.

-- "We expect (Unicom) to cut costs elsewhere in the organization so as to offset the nuclear cost rise," Everen said. "We will revise our model in detail and will probably be reducing our estimated 5.7 percent long term growth rate."
